about_the_game:
White Forest is an atmospheric first-person shooter that puts you in the role of a state patrol officer who is being continually drawn back into an unnatural area where mysterious and supernatural events keep occurring.

  • Mythical Roots: Heavily inspired by urban legends, creepypastas, and The X-Files, White Forest features a haunting cast of cryptids and horrors.

  • 12 Unique Chapters: Each chapter takes place in an open world environment where you are led by a trail of clues to discover chilling new domains and deadly encounters.

  • Immersive Design: White forest features a minimalist design which includes the removal of unnecessary HUD elements, so you can keep your eyes on the game world and the action.

  • Environmental Storytelling: Observe your surroundings to take in the story and progress through each chapter while you piece together an intricate overarching narrative.

  • More to Explore: The main path isn't the only thing to experience as there are multiple side paths and secrets littered throughout the world that change from chapter to chapter for the curious player to discover.

  • Evolving Game World: Your actions in each chapter have repercussions that persist through the chapters to follow, molding the world as you impress your will upon it.

  • Unlockable Arsenal: Weapons with exponentially increasing power are introduced as the player progresses through White Forest and can be used on past and future chapters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Version 1703 or later)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: An unnatural forest has even more unnatural secrets hiding within it. Discover what lies beneath the surface while you investigate trails of blood and carnage which will lead you to untold horrors in this atmospheric First-Person Shooter.
